summary: U.S. forces conducted limited strikes on Iranian air defenses while Iran reports casualties at Jask port and threatens retaliation against U.S. interests. Simultaneously, U.S. CENTCOM disabled a commercial vessel in the Gulf of Oman for breaching the naval blockade on Iran, and the IRGC claims two tankers struck mines near the Strait of Hormuz. Israeli artillery shelling continues along the Lebanese border, and former IDF Chief Gadi Eisenkot has been tasked with forming a new Israeli government.
